#!/bin/sh
set -eu
base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
exec python3 "$base/build.py"
"""Offline standard-library-only Rust build driver."""
import os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
base=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
tmp=os.environ.get('TMPDIR') or tempfile.gettempdir()
out=pathlib.Path(tmp)/'unit-merge-build'
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy();env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']='/opt/rust/lib'
flags=['/opt/rust/bin/rustc','--edition=2021','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl','-C','opt-level=2','-C','codegen-units=1','-A','warnings']
subprocess.run(flags+['--crate-name','rust_unit_merge','--crate-type','rlib',str(base/'src/lib.rs'),'-o',str(out/'librust_unit_merge.rlib')],env=env,check=True)
subprocess.run(flags+['--crate-name','rust_unit_merge_cli','-C','link-arg=--threads=2','-C','linker=/opt/rust/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rust-lld',str(base/'src/main.rs'),'--extern','rust_unit_merge='+str(out/'librust_unit_merge.rlib'),'-o',str(out/'engine')],env=env,check=True)
